mapper.select: select a.*,b.NAME as userName from PAN_FILE_RIGHT a left join SYS_USER b on a.OBJECT_ID = b.ID where a.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' order by b.NAME

select a.*,b.ID as rightId,b.RIGHT_VALUE as rightValue from PAN_USER_FILE a left join PAN_FILE_RIGHT b on a.ID = b.USER_FILE_ID and b.OBJECT_ID = #{userId} and b.DELETE_FLAG = 'NOT_DELETE' where a.ID = #{userFileId}
